verdict.rationale: The pack contains verbatim text captured from the public guidance pages on eftps.gov/eftps/ and irs.gov, which suggests the public reading surface returned readable content rather than a JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. The eftps.gov probes also got ordinary HTTP 404 responses instead of a challenge page. However, no probe records a successful fetch of the guidance pages with a named, identified user agent, and there is no robots.txt or llms.txt to state agent access policy. Missing for 10: an explicit probe showing HTTP 200 for the guidance pages with an identified user agent and no bot challenge, confirmation the content is server-rendered and not JS-dependent, and a published crawl policy (robots.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: Payments using this Web site or our voice response system must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date to be received timely by the IRS.
No new enrollments for individual taxpayers — Individual taxpayers can no longer create new EFTPS accounts.
You can always make a tax payment by calling our voice response system at 1.800.555.3453.
